Riley (CS): FYI — we flagged degraded embeddings + intermittent 5xxs that impacted several Priority accounts between 02:12–02:45 UTC (eu-west-1). Need coordinated customer comms + a bridge for tomorrow. Affected: AcmePay, Foresight, Kinetix. Any quick mitigation?
Aisha (CS Ops): Ack. Who can write a plain-language summary for customers? We also need a proposed credit/compensation and a suggested time for a live bridge.
Miguel (Eng): Quick tech summary for the note: autoscaler mis-scaled some embedding pools which caused aggressive KV-cache eviction. That led to cold-cache fallbacks and higher mem pressure; batch runners timed out under load. We're deploying a config rollback and increasing eviction thresholds as a hotfix. ETA for rollout: ~3.5 hrs.
Miguel (Eng): Relevant snippet from logs for internal use:
```logs
worker-embed-23 evict: cache_size=0.12 -> eviction_threshold=0.10
batch-runner[45] timeout at 02:23:45 UTC
kv-cache-miss-rate spike: 42% -> 87%
```
Samira (SE): I'll draft the customer message. Keep it short: apology, what happened at a high level, what we did, what we're doing next, and how we'll make it right. @Ben what do we offer for Priority customers here?
Ben (PM): For Priority: propose 10% service credit for the incident window + one week of elevated support (daily sync if they want). Jordan (Finance) please confirm.
Aisha (CS Ops): Draft outreach for review (feel free to edit inline):
```
Hi <Customer Rep>,

We saw an incident on <date> that caused degraded embeddings and 5xx errors for some requests between 02:12–02:45 UTC. We're very sorry for the disruption.

What happened (plain): a backend autoscaling change caused cache evictions that temporarily increased request timeouts. Our engineers rolled back the config and applied a patch; full stability checks are underway and we do not expect further impact.

What we did: rolled back autoscaler change, increased cache thresholds, deployed hotfix to batch runners.

What we're doing next: running an extended stress test and additional monitoring for 48h; offering a credit of 10% for the affected window; we can set up a 30-minute technical bridge to walk through logs and mitigation steps.

If you'd like a bridge, please pick a time here: https://cal.link/redwood-cs/priority-bridge

Again — apologies and we're committed to preventing recurrence.

— Riley, Customer Success
```
Samira (SE): I'll prep an appendix for the bridge with anonymized example logs and a short runbook for their SREs. Need engineering sign-off to share logs (strip PII/service tokens).
Miguel (Eng): Confirm sharing anonymized logs ok. We'll scrub request IDs and any customer payloads. Provide a small sanitized sample for the bridge.
Riley (CS): Proposed bridge: tomorrow 14:00 UTC. Can SEs + Eng join? Link: https://meet.redwood/bridge/183400
Samira (SE): I'll join and lead the demo. Will bring sanitized logs + timeline.
Ben (PM): Jordan, can you confirm the 10% credit approval?
Finance - Jordan: Confirmed — finance ok with 10% service credit for impacted invoices. Please include a short statement in the email about the credit being automatically applied to the next billing cycle.
Riley (CS): Great — I'll send the initial outreach to the three affected accounts now and include the bridge link. Posting the final copy here before send.
Riley (CS): Final sendable copy (sending now):
```
Hi <Customer Rep>,

We sincerely apologize — between 02:12–02:45 UTC on <date> some requests experienced degraded embeddings and intermittent 5xx responses. Our team traced the issue to an internal autoscaling configuration that led to cache evictions and timeouts. We rolled back the change and deployed a patch; stability checks are in progress.

We've applied a 10% service credit for the impacted window and can schedule a 30-minute bridge to review logs and mitigations. Book here: https://cal.link/redwood-cs/priority-bridge

If you'd like us to proactively run a health check on your onboarding flow, we can schedule that as well.

Sincerely,
Riley on behalf of Redwood CS & Eng
```
Aisha (CS Ops): Copy looks good. Please BCC the renewal/AE and include the support ticket link.
Miguel (Eng): After bridge, we'll publish a short RCA doc (non-technical and technical appendices). I'll add mitigation PRs and config diffs.
incident-bot: RCA draft created at /docs/rca/1834002000-draft.md — editors: Miguel, Riley, Samira
Riley (CS): Sent to AcmePay and Kinetix; Foresight requested an earlier bridge and we moved it to 12:30 UTC — Samira + Miguel can you make 12:30 work?
Samira (SE): I can do 12:30.
Miguel (Eng): I can make 12:30 — will bring scrubbed logs and the roll-back diff.
Riley (CS): Thanks everyone. After the bridge, please add any customer feedback to the onboarding/health-check tracker so we can tie this to renewal-risk notes. Will update account health flags once RCA final.
Ben (PM): Suggest follow-up action: proactively run quantized-model bench for Priority accounts and offer a 1-week performance audit.
Aisha (CS Ops): Noted — I'll add to the ops checklist and allocate an SE for the audit. :thumbsup:
Riley (CS): Closing the thread — will post the customer responses and meeting notes here after bridges.
